h1: The 6 Best Murphy Bed Cabinets for Studio Apartments of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Studio Murphy Bed Cabinets: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six assembled queen Murphy bed cabinets for studio apartments, compared on storage, charging, lighting, finish and lift mechanism.
mainKeyword: murphy bed cabinet for studio apartment
summary: The LUXOAK queen cabinet bed is our pick for maximum built-in storage, and the AMERLIFE is a close assembled alternative. The Yoobure adds drawers and a rattan look, the LIVAUVEAD is the budget-friendly white option, and the Hlivelood pair adds LED lighting and a gas strut lift at the top of the price range.
intro: Studio renters usually fixate on the bed and forget the room it leaves behind. A Murphy cabinet bed folds up to look like a wardrobe, but its folded depth and the clearance it needs to swing down can eat more floor than a plain bed frame if you do not plan the layout. The cabinet itself is the easy part; the wall, the ceiling and the desk placement are not.

We reviewed eight Murphy bed listings and set aside two bare hardware kits, since a kit is not a finished cabinet. The six that remain are assembled queen-size cabinets, ranked on the spec sheets for storage, charging, lift mechanism, lighting and finish, with a note that none of them includes a desk.

products.name: LUXOAK Queen Murphy Cabinet Bed with Storage and Charging Station
products.verdict: Storage compartments and a charging station in one assembled queen cabinet.
products.description:
The LUXOAK is a queen Murphy cabinet bed with built-in storage compartments and a charging station. It is listed as an assembled cabinet design, which spares you from sourcing and building a frame.

It ranks first because storage is what a studio lacks most, and this listing leads on compartments among the assembled cabinets. It sits in the mid price range with the AMERLIFE, so the choice between them comes down to the layout of the storage.

Best for a renter who wants the bed to double as a wardrobe wall. It does not include a desk, so plan one separately.
products.idealFor: Studio renters who want maximum storage in one piece.

products.name: AMERLIFE Queen Murphy Bed with Storage and Charging Station
products.verdict: Nearly the same feature list as the LUXOAK from a different maker.
products.description:
The AMERLIFE is a queen Murphy bed with built-in storage compartments and a charging station, in an assembled cabinet design. Its listed feature set mirrors the LUXOAK.

It ranks second because nothing in the listing separates it from the LUXOAK, so it takes the runner-up spot as a like-for-like option. Compare delivered dimensions and finish before choosing, since those are the real differences.

A good pick if the LUXOAK is unavailable or if you prefer its look. As with the others, a separate desk is part of the plan.
products.idealFor: Renters wanting a LUXOAK-style cabinet from another brand.
products.skipIf: You want a distinctive style or lighting.

products.name: Yoobure Queen Murphy Bed with Charging Station, Rattan Cabinet Bed with Storage Drawers
products.verdict: A rattan-finish cabinet bed with drawers and a charging station.
products.description:
The Yoobure is a queen foldable platform bed in a rattan cabinet finish, with storage drawers and a built-in charging station. The drawers give you pull-out space rather than open compartments.

It ranks third because the LUXOAK and AMERLIFE list more general storage, while this one trades some of that for a distinctive look. The rattan finish suits a boho or coastal studio.

Choose it for a studio where the cabinet is a visible design feature. If storage volume matters more than style, stay with the first two.
products.idealFor: Studios with a boho or coastal look.

products.name: LIVAUVEAD Farmhouse Queen Size Murphy Bed with Charging Station, White
products.verdict: A farmhouse white cabinet bed with basic charging at the lowest assembled price.
products.description:
The LIVAUVEAD is a queen Murphy bed in a farmhouse white finish with a built-in charging station, built as an assembled cabinet. Storage compartments are not listed.

It ranks fourth because it drops the storage the top two include, which is the main way a cabinet bed earns space in a studio. In exchange it is the lowest-priced assembled option, still in the mid price range.

A fit for renters who want a bed that folds away and look good in white. Skip it if the folded cabinet must double as a wardrobe.
products.idealFor: Budget-focused renters wanting a white cabinet.

products.name: Hlivelood Queen Size Murphy Bed with 2 LED Lights, Rustic White
products.verdict: A gas strut lift and two LED lights in a rustic white finish.
products.description:
This Hlivelood queen Murphy bed has two built-in LED lights, a gas strut mechanism and a rustic white finish. Gas struts assist the lift so folding the bed takes less effort.

It ranks fifth because it sits in the highest price range yet lists no storage or charging, so you pay for lighting and lift feel. It costs a little less than the brown version of the same design.

Pick it for a studio where evening lighting from the cabinet matters. If storage or charging is the priority, the LUXOAK is better value.

products.name: Hlivelood Queen Size Murphy Bed with 2 LED Lights, Brown
products.verdict: The same lit gas strut design in a brown finish at a higher price.
products.description:
The brown Hlivelood is the same queen Murphy design as the white one, with two LED lights and a gas strut lift. The difference is the brown finish.

It ranks last because it costs more than the rustic white version for the same listed features. If you prefer a darker cabinet the premium is the cost of color.

Choose it only if brown suits your studio better than white. Otherwise buy the rustic white version and save.
products.idealFor: Studios wanting a darker lit cabinet.
products.skipIf: You are indifferent to finish color.

whatMatters.detail: A Murphy bed folds into a cabinet, but it needs open floor to swing down when in use. That clearance is often larger than shoppers expect and can block a doorway or desk. Measure the room from the wall to the nearest obstacle and compare with the listing dimensions.

Cabinet beds that include compartments or drawers replace a dresser, saving floor space. Without them you need separate storage. Look for the words compartments or drawers in the title or bullet points.
Gas struts or pistons assist the lift so the bed rises and lowers with less effort. Weak assistance makes folding a daily chore. Check whether the listing names gas struts.
Folded height, ceiling clearance and a stable wall matter in rentals. Check the listing for assembled height and whether the cabinet needs wall anchoring, and confirm your lease allows it.

A built-in charging station keeps a phone reachable without an extra table, and LED lights act as bedside lighting. Both are small but used daily. Check which of the two the listing includes, since few have both.

cards.label: Storage focus
cards.text: Storage cabinets replace a dresser and free floor space. The LUXOAK, AMERLIFE and Yoobure list storage.

cards.label: Lighting focus
cards.text: Built-in LEDs give bedside light and a gas strut lift. The two Hlivelood models offer both and sit in the highest price range.

howToChoose.note: Most studio renters should default to storage unless lighting is truly missing.

howToChoose.subheading: For Renters Needing a Desk Specifically

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A cabinet with a desk built in, or a layout with floor space left over for a separate desk.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: None of these six includes a desk, so pair the LUXOAK or LIVAUVEAD with a wall-mounted or folding desk on another wall.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want built-in lighting and a gas strut lift, which means the Hlivelood pair.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: Storage and charging cover your needs. The LUXOAK and AMERLIFE give more storage for less money.

faq.q: Are these Murphy beds ready to use?
faq.a: They are described as assembled cabinet designs, but you may still need to anchor and fit them. Check the listing and plan time for installation.

faq.q: What mistake do studio renters make most?
faq.a: Ignoring the swing-down clearance. The bed needs open floor in front of it, so measure before you choose.

faq.q: Is the Hlivelood worth it over the LUXOAK?
faq.a: Only if built-in lighting and a gas strut lift matter. The LUXOAK offers storage and charging at a lower price range.
The listings do not state a mattress, so assume you will supply a queen mattress and confirm the thickness limit.

faq.q: Can I use one in a rental?
faq.a: Check your lease, because many cabinet beds need wall anchoring. Ask your landlord before buying.

faq.q: Do any of these include a desk?
faq.a: No. Plan a separate desk or wall-mounted option for your studio.

finalTake: The LUXOAK queen cabinet bed is the strongest all-round choice for a studio, with storage and charging in an assembled piece. The AMERLIFE is the like-for-like alternative, the Yoobure adds style, and the Hlivelood pair is for buyers who value lighting and lift feel over storage.
